english.title: Cause use of a motor vehicle windscreen washers not fitted

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: ROAD VEHICLES CONSTRUCTION AND USE REGULATIONS 1986

english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) caused **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) to use on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), fitted with one or more windscreen wipers when it was not also fitted with a windscreen washer capable of cleaning the area of the windscreen swept by the wiper of mud or similar deposit.
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 34(2)of the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986, section 42 of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
caused to be used on a road a motor vehicle fitted with one or more windscreen wipers
not fitted with a windscreen washer capable of cleaning the windscreen

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) See regulation 34(3),(4) and (5) for exceptions.
(ii) This requirement does not apply to rear window wipers/washers.
(iii) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
(iv) See also offence wordings: H185 and H197.
english.standardstatementoffacts: At **(..SPECIFY TIME..) on **(..SPECIFY DATE..) the defendant caused **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) to use **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..) on **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..) when no windscreen washer capable of cleaning the windscreen was fitted.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale if in respect of goods vehicle or vehicle adapted to carry more than eight passengers.
A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale in any other case.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
